strings.name: Uday Kotak
strings.role: Founder and non-executive director of Kotak Mahindra Bank
strings.summary: Uday Kotak founded a financial business in 1985 that later became Kotak Mahindra Bank. After a long tenure as managing director and CEO, he became a non-executive, non-independent director in 2023. He also chaired a committee established by India's securities regulator to advise on listed-company governance.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Founder and current CEO, non-executive and independent director, advisory committee and regulator, and restrictions on the bank and personal responsibility are distinguished. Market forecasts remain attributed opinions.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded the Kotak financial business and developed it into a major bank, influencing India's private financial sector.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Completed undergraduate studies at Sydenham College, earning a commerce degree from Mumbai University; completed a master's in management studies at JBIMS in 1982.
strings.facts.f2.label: Board status
strings.facts.f2.value: A non-executive, non-independent director of the bank since September 2, 2023; no longer managing director and CEO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From non-bank finance to banking
strings.highlights.h1.text: Founded the business in 1985; in 2003 it became India's first non-banking finance company to convert into a bank.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Participation in governance reform
strings.highlights.h2.text: Chaired SEBI's 2017 advisory committee studying issues including director independence, disclosure and shareholder participation at listed companies.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Financial summit report updated
strings.timeline.t1.text: Business Standard reported his discussion of foreign-currency deposit repayment risks at a Mumbai summit; this is the article's update date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Specific restrictions on the bank lifted
strings.timeline.t2.text: Following remediation and an external audit, RBI lifted the 2024 restrictions on online onboarding of new customers and new credit cards imposed over IT governance issues.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes a non-executive director
strings.timeline.t3.text: Ended his tenure as managing director and CEO and became a non-executive, non-independent director.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Chairs governance advisory committee
strings.timeline.t4.text: SEBI established a committee under his chairmanship to recommend improvements to governance at Indian listed companies.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Wins EY World Entrepreneur Of The Year
strings.timeline.t5.text: Received the global award, distinct from the 2013 India Entrepreneur Of The Year award.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Financial business converts into a bank
strings.timeline.t6.text: Kotak Mahindra Finance became India's first non-banking finance company to convert into a bank.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds a financial business
strings.timeline.t7.text: Started building the business that would become Kotak Mahindra Finance.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes postgraduate management studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed a master's in management studies at Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies.
